name: Embed Outline
changes: As you scroll, the outline marks the section at the top of the note, also inside embedded notes.
Turn the mark off with the new setting Highlight the current section.
tip: Click a heading row in an embedded note to scroll to that heading inside the embed.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Embed Outline is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it.
